caption: “Common mullein (Verbascum thapsus) with an associated moth and its anatomical segments.” Etching with watercolor. London: J. Curtis, 1831. From the Wellcome Collection.
alt: A hand-colored etching of a common mullein stalk, its tall spike crowded with yellow flowers above broad, woolly leaves, with a brown moth beside it and small drawings of the moth’s parts below.
bibliography: Curtis, J. "Common Mullein (Verbascum thapsus) with an Associated Moth and Its Anatomical Segments." Etching with watercolour, 1831, Wellcome Collection, London.
